subject: Culture
title: Singles' Day in China
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Singles' Day in China.

hook.text: Chinese university students invented Singles' Day in 1993 as a joke. Now it's the world's largest shopping event.

buildup.text: November 11—11/11—was chosen because the 1s resemble single people standing alone.

discovery.text: Alibaba turned it into a commerce spectacle in 2009. Live concerts, celebrity shows, and a countdown clock.

twist.text: Singles' Day now dwarfs Black Friday and Cyber Monday combined. A student joke became a global retail force.

climax.text: Technology can turn any random date into a cultural phenomenon if the marketing machine is strong enough.

punchline.text: A joke between students built a $100 billion holiday.

quiz.question: Why was November 11th chosen for Singles' Day?
options: The 1s resemble single people standing alone

details.summary: Singles' Day (November 11 — 11/11, resembling four lonely ones) began as a Chinese university anti-Valentine's celebration in the 1990s. Alibaba transformed it into the world's largest shopping event in 2009, generating over $80 billion in sales in a single day by the 2020s.
details.whyItMatters: Singles' Day shows how a grassroots cultural moment can be captured and commercialized into a global economic event. It now dwarfs Black Friday and Cyber Monday combined.
takeaways: Singles' Day started as an anti-Valentine's Day celebration by students
Alibaba turned it into a shopping event in 2009
It generates more sales than Black Friday and Cyber Monday combined

faq.question: How did Alibaba create the shopping festival?
faq.answer: In 2009, Alibaba's Daniel Zhang launched a one-day sales event on November 11 with just 27 participating brands. The combination of steep discounts, limited-time offers, and social media buzz created a shopping frenzy.

faq.question: Has Singles' Day spread beyond China?
faq.answer: Yes. Southeast Asian platforms like Lazada and Shopee run major 11.11 sales events. Western retailers including Amazon increasingly offer Singles' Day promotions.
